# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global social media platform enabling creators, businesses, and communities to connect through short-form video content with integrated advertising, commerce, and safety features.

TikTok provides comprehensive resources for businesses to advertise and market their brands through innovative ad formats, creator partnerships, and commerce integrations. The platform also emphasizes user safety, community guidelines, and parental controls to foster a secure environment for its diverse audience.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- Branded Hashtag Challenge
- Ads Manager
- Creator Marketplace
- TikTok Shop
- In-Feed Ads
- Spark Ads
- TopView Ads
- User-Generated Content

- Social Media Marketing
- Customer Acquisition
- Creator Partnership
- For You Feed

- [TikTok for Business | Marketing & Advertising on TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG): TikTok for Business hub: advertising solutions, campaigns, and business tools

## Case Studies & Success Stories

- [Parc Asterix | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/parc-asterix-202): Parc Asterix case study: launching official TikTok account for brand engagement
- [Mango | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/mango-188): Mango case study: generating TikTok profile awareness among Spanish youth
- [TOA Paint Group | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/toa-paint-group-316): TOA Paint Group case study: driving awareness via hashtag challenge in Thailand
- [Planswell | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/planswell-308): Planswell case study: fintech brand connecting with ad-fatigued Canadian audiences
- [Coconut Lane | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/coconut-lane-273): Coconut Lane case study: driving ecommerce conversions via Shopify integration
- [Up | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/up-347): Up case study: building fintech brand awareness through Spark Ads and creators
- [BiGDUG | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/bigdug-237): BiGDUG case study: B2B brand awareness via TikTok creator marketplace collaboration
- [Tzuki Indonesia | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/tzuki-indonesia-228): Tzuki Indonesia case study: beauty brand engagement through in-feed ads and creators
- [Lactacyd | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/lactacyd-376): Lactacyd case study: brand awareness via hashtag challenge in Vietnam market
- [VYS Games | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/vys-games-206): VYS Games case study: mobile game promotion through authentic TikTok advertising
- [Amazon Prime Video Italy | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/amazon-prime-video-italy-219): Amazon Prime Video Italy case study: holiday campaign via hashtag challenge
- [PURELEI | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/purelei-280): PURELEI case study: brand awareness via International Women's Day campaign

## Safety & Community

- [Our approach to safety](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/our-approach-to-safety): TikTok's safety principles, community guidelines, and privacy controls overview
- [Guardian's Guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-sg/guardians-guide): Parental guide to TikTok features, safety tools, and internet safety for teens
